label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y harás varas al altar, varas de maderas de shitím, y las revestirás bronce.
spanish: Y harás varas al altar, varas de maderas de acacia, y las revestirás de bronce.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration "shitím" with its lexical sense "acacia" for h02027006006 (HNcfpa, Strongs H7848), per the cited auditor fail; no participant, number, or stem change.
Added the preposition "de" before "bronce" ("revestirás de bronce"), required by Spanish "revestir de algo"; same participants and object, grammar only.
